item.title: Weather: Dense fog disrupts transport services across North India; Cold wave persists
item.description: Severe cold wave and dense fog conditions continue to affect North India, disrupting road, rail, and air transport. Visibility dropped to near zero in several regions, delaying more than 50 trains and multiple flights. Snowfall in hilly states and freezing temperatures in plains intensified the impact.

item.title: Gold prices jump Rs 3,320 in a week; Silver steals the show with massive surge
item.description: Gold prices continued their weekly uptrend in India, rising ₹3,320 for 24-carat gold, while silver witnessed a sharp surge of ₹35,000 per kilogram. Strong global cues, easing inflation data, and expectations of interest rate cuts boosted demand for safe-haven assets.

item.title: Mauni Amavasya holy dip begins; Massive crowd gathers at Prayagraj Sangam
item.description: The Mauni Amavasya bathing festival, the biggest event of the Magh Mela, began at Prayagraj with millions of devotees taking a holy dip at the Sangam. Bathing started from the Brahma Muhurat amid tight security arrangements.

item.title: Political buzz grows over BMC mayor post after Poll results; Power-sharing formula in focus
item.description: Political activity has intensified over the BMC mayor post following the municipal election results. Parties are closely watching the reservation lottery, which will decide the category of the mayor. Amid speculation, discussions around a two-and-a-half-year power-sharing formula between alliance partners have gained momentum.

item.title: The MTA Speaks: How Budget 2026 will impact the common man, middle class, and startups?
item.description: The Budget Session 2026 is set to play a decisive role in shaping India’s economic direction. With high expectations from the middle class, youth, startups, and investors, the Union Budget will focus on growth, inflation control, tax relief, and job creation. Read an exclusive analysis by veteran journalist Manoj Tibrewal Aakash.

item.title: Indian sailors held hostage in Iran for over a month; Families seek PM Modi’s intervention
item.description: The sailors were detained after their vessel was allegedly seized despite being in international waters. With Iran currently witnessing violent protests and instability, anxiety over the crew’s safety has intensified.

item.title: Greenland row escalates as Trump targets eight European Nations with tariffs; Details here
item.description: Tensions have risen between the United States and Europe after President Donald Trump announced tariffs on eight European countries over the Greenland issue. The move drew sharp criticism from allies, with former US officials calling it irrational and harmful to security cooperation.

item.title: Mrunal Thakur shares first post amid wedding speculations with Dhanush; Are they really getting married?
item.description: Actress Mrunal Thakur has finally shared her first social media post amid ongoing marriage rumors with South superstar Dhanush. The video, set on a yacht with AR Rahman’s song playing, shows her enjoying serene moments at sea.

item.title: Maharashtra CM Fadnavis meets US Ambassador Sergio Gor to boost investment; Full details
item.description: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis met US Ambassador Sergio Gore to discuss boosting American investment in the state and expanding trade ties. Key topics included support for Maharashtra companies in the US and strategic projects like Navi Mumbai International Education City.
